note: Tool catalog for the tool-routing mini-experiment. 'none' is added by the harness as an abstain option (no listed tool fits; the agent answers directly or the request is out of scope).

tools.desc: Search the codebase for a symbol, string, or pattern and report where it appears.
Read the contents of a specific file at a known path.
Run the project's automated test suite and report pass/fail.
Run the linter / static analysis and report violations.
Show the current git branch, uncommitted changes, and diff summary.
Open a pull request for the current branch.
Run a read-only query against the application database and return rows.
Deploy the current build to the staging environment.
Roll back the most recent production release to the previous version.
Post a message to a team Slack channel.
Search the public web for external, up-to-date information.
Hand the decision off to a human operator for approval (use for high-consequence or policy-bound judgments).
